daily_reality.typical_workday: Hospital/clinical dietitians: assess patients' nutritional needs, develop meal plans, provide nutrition counseling, chart in EHR, attend interdisciplinary rounds. Community/outpatient: individual and group counseling sessions, develop educational materials, conduct cooking demonstrations. Administrative time for documentation, care plans, and continuing education. Typical 40-hour work week.
key_documents: Clinical documentation in EHR (ADIME or SOAP notes)
daily_reality.deadlines: CDR credential renewal every 5 years with 75 CPEUs. State license renewal cycles. Patient discharge diet planning timelines. Research grant deadlines for academic dietitians. Quality reporting deadlines for hospital dietitians.
daily_reality.seasonality: New Year's resolution period (January) drives demand for counseling. National Nutrition Month (March) increases visibility. Holiday season creates demand for weight management. Diabetes awareness month (November) drives screenings.

laws_and_standards: State dietitian/nutritionist licensing laws (varies — some states license, others certify or have title protection)
regulatory.licensing: RDN (Registered Dietitian Nutritionist) credential through CDR (Commission on Dietetic Registration). Starting 2024, graduate degree required for new RDNs (master's minimum). Complete ACEND-accredited didactic program and supervised practice. Pass CDR registration exam. State licensure required in most states (varies). 75 CPEUs every 5 years for renewal.
regulatory.penalties: State board actions for practicing without license. Loss of RDN credential for CE non-compliance. Malpractice liability for adverse nutrition outcomes. CMS penalties for billing fraud. Title protection violations in states with certification laws.
regulatory_bodies: ACEND (Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics)

software: ESHA Genesis - food formulation and labeling
platforms: Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics eatrightPRO - professional resources
Telehealth platforms (Zoom, Doxy.me) for virtual counseling
Healthie - practice management for private practice RDNs

jargon: ADIME documentation (Assessment, Diagnosis, Intervention, Monitoring, Evaluation)
abbreviations: IDDSI - International Dysphagia Diet Standardisation Initiative
AND - Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics
ACEND - Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics

career_levels: Specialized: Renal, Oncology, Pediatric, Sports, etc.
fears: Low pay relative to education and credential requirements (master's degree now required)
Scope creep from unqualified 'nutritionists' and health coaches
Student loan burden for master's degree
career_psychology.motivation: Direct impact on patient health through food and nutrition; growing recognition of diet's role in chronic disease; flexible career paths (clinical, community, private practice, corporate wellness, food industry); 7% job growth projected — faster than average.
career_psychology.burnout: Moderate burnout in hospital settings due to high patient loads and time pressure. Documentation burden in EHR. Emotional labor of counseling patients with chronic conditions. Better work-life balance in outpatient/private practice settings. Staffing shortages in hospital foodservice departments.

associations: AND (Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics) — largest, >112,000 members
ASPEN (American Society for Parenteral and Enteral Nutrition)
Dietitians in Integrative and Functional Medicine (DIFM)
conferences: AND FNCE (Food & Nutrition Conference & Expo) - annual, October
Academy Integrative Health and Medicine Conference

market.job_count_estimate: About 84,000 dietitians and nutritionists in the US (BLS). 7% projected growth 2023-2033 (faster than average). Growing demand in hospitals, outpatient clinics, corporate wellness, and private practice.
market.work_arrangements: Hospitals (largest employer), outpatient clinics, long-term care, community health centers, private practice, corporate wellness programs, food industry. Standard 40-hour weeks. Growing telehealth/virtual counseling options. Part-time and flexible scheduling common.
trends: Master's degree requirement for new RDNs (effective 2024)
Aging population driving demand for MNT
AI tools for meal planning and nutrient analysis
Growing private practice and direct-to-consumer models
RDN Salary Calculator from Academy helping negotiate compensation
